changelog: Added 75 new primitives (directional + tight variants preserved) + 34 true synonym mappings

abc_correction.description: Three-leg corrective move (A-B-C) against the prior trend, often forming a pullback before trend resumption or reversal.

always_in_long.description: Market condition where longs are favored continuously

always_in_short.description: Market condition where shorts are favored continuously

always_in.description: Always In concept (direction-neutral; use always_in_long/always_in_short when specified).

buy_signal_bar.description: Buy signal bar (bar that triggers a buy entry).

sell_signal_bar.description: Sell signal bar (bar that triggers a sell entry).

entry_bar.description: Entry bar (the bar used for entry execution/trigger).

price_action.description: Price action concept (bar-by-bar context and patterns).

scalp.description: Scalp concept (short-duration trade targeting small moves).

surprise_bar.description: A surprisingly big trend bar relative to recent bars showing unexpected strength. Signals the market needs to reprice and usually leads to at least a small 2nd leg in the surprise direction. Impacts roughly the next 5-20 bars. Types include breakout, reversal, exhaustion, and give-up. Tied to measured moves.

bear_surprise_bar.description: Bear surprise bar (directional surprise bar down).

bull_surprise_bar.description: Bull surprise bar (directional surprise bar up).

major_surprise_bar.description: Major surprise bar (especially big/important surprise bar).

trend_day.description: Trend day (day type characterized by sustained trending behavior).

inside_outside_inside.description: Inside-Outside-Inside (IOI) pattern (an outside bar surrounded by inside bars).

trend_bar.description: Trend bar (strong directional bar, often with close near extreme).

session_extreme_high.description: Session high extreme (High of Day / HOD).

session_extreme_low.description: Session low extreme (Low of Day / LOD).

price_magnet.description: Price magnet concept (a level above/below that price is drawn toward).

synonyms: federal open market committee meeting and announcement

backtest_overfitting.description: Risk that backtest results are inflated due to curve-fitting to historical noise and non-robust parameter choices.

bar_by_bar_reading.description: Interpreting price action one bar at a time to infer context, strength, and likely next move.

bar_counting.description: Technique of counting bars since a signal, breakout, or swing point to time entries/exits and assess pattern maturity.

barb_wire.description: Tight overlapping bars with dojis, difficult to trade

bear_reversal.description: Bearish reversal concept (reversal down / selling reversal).

bull_reversal.description: Bullish reversal concept (reversal up / buying reversal).

channel.description: Channel concept (sloping range with roughly parallel trendlines).

pullback.description: Pullback concept (countertrend move within a larger trend).

resistance.description: Resistance level/zone where sellers are expected (or have previously been active).

reversal_bar.description: Reversal bar concept (signal bar / reversal bar).

support.description: Support level/zone where buyers are expected (or have previously been active).

bear_flag_around_moving_average_trap.description: Bear flag forming around a moving average that traps bears before reversing up.

bear_ledge.description: Bearish ledge pattern: tight sideways-to-down consolidation with repeated highs at/near the same price acting as resistance before a breakout down.

signal_bar.description: Bar that signals a potential reversal - good body with close in direction of reversal, appearing after opposite-direction context. Triggers entry setups.

two_bar_reversal.description: Reversal pattern formed by two consecutive bars signaling a change in direction (often a strong entry signal).

breakout_bar.description: Bar that breaks above/below the high/low of prior N bars, initiating potential new move. Strength measured by number of prior bars exceeded.

failed_breakout.description: Breakout that reverses back into range

gap_bar.description: Bar with no overlap with previous bar - gap up (current low > previous high) or gap down (current high < previous low). Shows urgency.

buying_pressure.description: Persistent net buying that supports higher prices (often seen as strong bull closes, repeated higher lows, or inability to sustain selloffs).

selling_pressure.description: Persistent dominance of sellers, seen as repeated bear closes, strong bear bodies, and/or inability of bulls to sustain rallies.

bracket_oco_orders.description: Bracket order management using OCO (one-cancels-other) entries/exits (e.g., stop + target).

breakaway_gap.description: A gap that breaks price out of a consolidation or pattern, often starting a new trend and tending not to fill quickly.

breakout.description: Price breaks above resistance or below support, often initiating a new leg or trend.

breakout_mode.description: Trading range state where price is coiling and likely to break out up or down (breakout mode).

bull_flag_around_moving_average_trap.description: Bull flag forming around a moving average where a pullback/MA test traps shorts before resuming uptrend.

bull_ledge.description: Bullish ledge pattern: tight sideways-to-up consolidation with repeated lows at/near the same price acting as support before a breakout up.

buy_climax.description: Late bull trend climactic behavior, potential top

buy_vacuum.description: Rapid price rise driven by urgent buying and lack of sell liquidity, often into resistance and prone to stalling/reversal.

channel_as_flag.description: A tight channel that functions as a flag (pullback) within a larger trend, typically leading to trend resumption breakout.

cherry_picking_risk.description: Bias from selecting only favorable examples/trades, leading to overstated performance or edge.

commission_drag.description: Performance degradation from commissions/fees (and related frictions) reducing net expectancy, especially for high-frequency trading.

consecutive_trend_bars.description: Multiple consecutive bars in same direction

countertrend_trading.description: Trading against the prevailing trend, typically targeting pullbacks or reversals.

crowded_trade_reversal.description: Reversal driven by overcrowded positioning (late entrants trapped, forced exits, or profit-taking cascade).

deep_pullback.description: A pullback that retraces a large portion of the prior move (often testing key support/resistance) before trend continuation or reversal.

doji.description: Bar with small or no body, indecision

dominant_feature.description: A huge surprise bar big enough to dominate the rest of the day (and sometimes multiple days). Essentially a very large surprise bar with extended influence on price action.

double_bottom_bull_flag.description: Bull flag continuation pattern resembling a double bottom (W) within a pullback before trend resumption.

double_top_bear_flag.description: Bear flag that forms a double top before resuming down, often a second-entry short context.

dueling_trendlines.description: Price compresses between opposing trendlines (bull and bear lines) creating a tight decision zone before breakout.

efficient_market_dynamics.description: How information, liquidity, and participant behavior drive price discovery and randomness.

efficient_market_hypothesis.description: The view that prices reflect available information, limiting persistent exploitable edges.

equidistant_move_probability.description: Probability framing based on equal-distance moves (e.g., odds of reaching +X vs -X first).

exhaustion_gap.description: A late-trend gap signaling potential trend exhaustion and increased reversal risk.

expanding_triangle.description: A broadening formation with higher highs and lower lows (megaphone) indicating increasing volatility and two-sided trading.

expectancy_math.description: Trade expectancy concepts and calculations (win rate, average win/loss, expectancy per trade).

failed_wedge_short.description: Short setup after a wedge pattern fails (wedge breakout or reversal attempt fails, leading to downside).

final_flag.description: Last flag/pullback late in a trend that often precedes trend exhaustion and a reversal or deeper correction.

five_tick_failure.description: Very small breakout/attempt (often a few ticks) that fails quickly and reverses, used as a scalp signal.

follow_through.description: Confirmation price action after a signal bar/breakout, indicating continuation or failure.

fractal_timeframe_invariance.description: Assumption that price action patterns and behaviors repeat similarly across timeframes.

gap_open_strength.description: Assessing the strength/quality of an opening gap to infer trend potential and trade tactics.

gap_reversal.description: Reversal setup where a gap up/down fails and price reverses direction, often closing the gap.

head_and_shoulders_as_flag.description: A head-and-shoulders-shaped pullback that functions as a continuation flag within a larger trend.

hedging.description: Reducing net exposure by taking offsetting positions or instruments to manage risk.

high_1.description: First pullback in bull trend (High 1 setup)
synonyms: one legged pullback in a bull move

high_2.description: Second pullback in bull trend (High 2 setup)

high_4.description: Fourth pullback in an uptrend (High 4) used as a continuation entry setup after three prior pullbacks.

high_frequency_trading.description: Ultra-short-term automated trading using very high order rates and low-latency execution.

ignore_news_flow.description: Deliberately not incorporating news/events into trade decisions, relying on price action only.

indicator_overreliance.description: Excessive dependence on indicators at the expense of context, leading to poor decisions.

indicator_skepticism.description: A preference for price action/context over indicator signals due to lag and false precision.

inflection_area.description: A price zone where the market is likely to change behavior (support/resistance pivot) and traders watch for reversal or acceleration.

information_hygiene.description: Managing information inputs to reduce noise and maintain decision quality (sources, timing, volume).

inside_bar.description: Bar with high/low within prior bar range

institutional_context.description: Contextual factors from institutional participation (e.g., session opens, news, order flow/liquidity zones) used to frame trade decisions.

island_reversal.description: Reversal pattern where price gaps away from a range and later gaps back, leaving an isolated 'island' of bars.

ledge_pattern.description: Tight sideways pause/step (ledge) that can act as a continuation or reversal structure (bull or bear ledge).

low_1.description: First pullback in bear trend (Low 1 setup)
synonyms: one legged pullback in a bear move

low_2.description: Second pullback in bear trend (Low 2 setup)

low_4.description: Fourth pullback in a downtrend (Low 4) used as a continuation entry setup after three prior pullbacks.

martingale_risk.description: Risk approach that increases position size after losses to recover prior losses, often via averaging down/up.

measured_move.description: Price projection based on a prior swing or range height, expecting a similar distance move from a breakout or reversal point.

measuring_gap.description: Gap that often marks midpoint of move

media_noise.description: Low-signal media commentary that distracts from actionable market information.

micro_channel.description: Tight sequence of small trend bars with little/no pullback, often leading to a climactic move or breakout test.

micro_double_bottom.description: Small double bottom pattern on lower timeframe

micro_double_top.description: Small double top pattern on lower timeframe

micro_trend_line.description: A short-term trendline drawn over a small number of bars to define immediate trend direction and signal minor breakouts or reversals.

micro_wedge.description: Small wedge pattern (typically 3 pushes) on a lower timeframe or within a larger pattern.

momentum_programs.description: Algorithmic/institutional buying or selling that accelerates price movement in the direction of momentum.

moving_average_gap.description: Price separating from a moving average by an unusually large distance, often used as an overextension/mean-reversion context.

negative_gap.description: A gap down where the current bar opens below the prior bar's low (down gap).

news_bias.description: Cognitive bias where news narratives skew market interpretation and trade decisions.

news_filtering.description: Selecting which news/events to consider and which to ignore to avoid noise-driven decisions.

opening_reversal.description: A reversal setup occurring near the session open, often after an opening drive or gap, where early direction fails and price reverses.

outside_bar.description: Bar with high/low beyond prior bar range

poor_signal_bar.description: Signal bar that reduces trade quality

position_sizing.description: Determining trade size based on risk, volatility, and account constraints to manage exposure.

price_action_rationale.description: The underlying reasoning for why a price action setup should work given context and incentives.

price_action_reading.description: Reading market structure and order-flow clues directly from price bars without indicators.

price_magnets.description: Areas/prices that tend to attract price (e.g., prior highs/lows, gaps, measured move targets, round numbers).

prior_signal_bar_target.description: Using a prior signal bar (or its high/low) as a target/magnet for exits or partial profits.

probability_mindset.description: Framing outcomes as probabilistic and focusing on process over individual trade results.

process_over_outcome.description: Emphasizing adherence to a repeatable trading process over short-term P&L outcomes.

profit_taking_covering.description: Reversal or pause driven by traders taking profits and shorts covering after an extended move.

pullback_entry.description: Entry on pullback within existing trend

reward_risk_compensation.description: Idea that lower probability setups require higher reward/risk (and vice versa) to be viable.

reward_risk_ratio.description: The ratio of expected reward (target) to risk (stop) used to evaluate trade structure.

risk_management.description: Position sizing, stop placement, and trade management rules to control downside and volatility of outcomes.

scale_in_scalp.description: Scalping tactic that scales into a position with multiple entries to improve average price and exit on a small move.

scaling_in_out.description: Managing a position by adding and reducing size in multiple tranches during the trade.

scalp_vs_swing.description: Discussion of scalp vs swing trade approaches

second_entry_long.description: Second attempt long entry after first pullback

second_entry_short.description: Second attempt short entry after first pullback

second_leg_down.description: Second leg down concept (follow-on leg lower after first leg down).

two_legs.description: Two legs / two-push concept (generic two-legged structure).

buy_the_close.description: Buy The Close (BTC) market state / tactic.

sell_the_close.description: Sell The Close (STC) market state / tactic.

sell_climax.description: Late bear trend climactic behavior, potential bottom

sell_vacuum.description: A vacuum move downward where selling accelerates toward a downside magnet (prior low/support) as stops trigger, often ending in exhaustion and bounce.

spike_and_channel.description: A trend structure with an initial sharp spike followed by a more orderly channel phase.

spike_and_channel_bull_trend.description: Bull spike and channel trend (directional variant).

stair_step_trend.description: A trend that advances in steps: impulse legs followed by brief consolidations/pullbacks.

stop_run.description: A move designed to trigger clustered stops beyond a prior swing/high/low, often followed by reversal or acceleration.

stop_run_dynamics.description: Price behavior driven by triggering clustered stops (liquidity grab), often causing spikes and reversals.

system_trust.description: Adhering to a validated trading plan through variance without abandoning it prematurely.

three_push_pullback.description: A pullback that unfolds in three distinct pushes/legs (often a wedge-like correction) before resuming the prior trend or reversing.

timeframe_mismatch.description: Using signals from one timeframe while managing risk/targets on an incompatible timeframe.

trade_equivalence_reentry.description: Treating a stopped-out trade and an immediate re-entry as equivalent to holding through, based on context and math.

trader_flexibility.description: Willingness to change bias or tactics as new information and context emerge.

traders_equation.description: Framework relating probability, reward/risk, and trade management to profitability (the trader's equation).

trading_discipline.description: Consistent execution of rules for entries, exits, sizing, and risk management despite emotions.

trading_edge.description: A repeatable statistical advantage that yields positive expectancy over many trades.

trading_psychology.description: Mental and emotional factors affecting trading decisions, discipline, and risk-taking.

trading_range.description: Sideways price action with defined support/resistance

trailing_stop.description: A stop-loss that moves in the trade's favor to lock in gains or reduce risk as price advances.

trailing_stop_swing_low.description: Trailing stop method that ratchets the stop to the most recent swing low (for longs) as the trade moves in favor.

trap_pattern.description: Setup where traders are lured into a breakout/entry that quickly reverses, trapping them.

trapped_bulls.description: Trapped bulls (bulls who bought and are trapped after a failed move up).

trap_trading.description: Trading setups that exploit trapped traders after a failed breakout/breakdown or reversal.

trend_channel_line_undershoot.description: Price briefly breaks past the trend channel line (overshoots/undershoots) before reversing back into the channel, often signaling exhaustion or a trap.

trend_from_the_open.description: Intraday session that trends strongly from the open with minimal pullbacks, often offering early entries and measured-move targets.

trend_strength.description: Assessment of how strong a trend is (e.g., momentum, slope, overlap, pullback depth) to guide trade selection.

trend_weakening_sequence.description: A sequence of price action showing loss of trend strength (e.g., smaller trend bars, more overlap, more pullbacks) often preceding a trading range or reversal.

trending_range.description: A trading range with a directional drift (overlapping bars but higher highs/lows or lower highs/lows).

trending_trading_range_bear.description: A bear-biased trading range that trends downward overall (a weak bear trend with frequent reversals).

trendline_break_retest.description: A trendline break followed by a pullback/retest of the broken line as support/resistance.

triangle_breakout_mode.description: Breakout Mode setup where price compresses into a triangle and is poised to break out in either direction.

triangle_pattern.description: Triangle consolidation pattern (symmetrical/ascending/descending) formed by converging trendlines.

twenty_gap_bars.description: A trend condition where bars do not touch the moving average for ~20 or more bars, indicating strong trend and limited pullbacks.

two_legged_pullback.description: Pullback that unfolds in two legs (two pushes) against the trend before resuming the trend.

two_reasons_rule.description: Trade filter requiring at least two independent reasons (confluence) to take a setup (e.g., pattern + context/support-resistance).

two_sided_trading.description: Trading both long and short (or buying and selling) within the same market context, often in a range or breakout mode, without a persistent directional bias.

vacuum_effect.description: Price accelerates toward a nearby magnet (prior high/low, gap, measured move) due to stop orders and thin liquidity, often leading to overshoot and potential reversal.

vacuum_move.description: A fast directional move through an area with little opposing order flow or support/resistance.

wedge_bull_flag.description: Bull flag pattern shaped as a wedge (typically a falling wedge) that breaks out upward in the direction of the prior bull trend.

win_probability_estimation.description: Estimating probability of winning (or reaching targets) to inform trade selection and sizing.

time_open.description: The open - first 30 min of RTH session (bars 1-6, 8:30-9:00 CT)

time_opening_range.description: Opening range - first hour of RTH session (bars 1-12, 8:30-9:30 CT)

time_close.description: The close - final 30 min before regular close (bars 73-78, 2:30-3:00 PM CT)

time_after_close.description: Final bars after regular close (bars 79-81, 3:00-3:15 PM CT)

regime_strong_bull_trend.description: Strong uptrend with minimal pullbacks and strong bull closes

regime_strong_bear_trend.description: Strong downtrend with minimal pullbacks and strong bear closes

regime_trading_range.description: Sideways price action with defined support/resistance boundaries

regime_bull_trend_pullback.description: Bull trend experiencing a pullback/correction phase

regime_bear_trend_pullback.description: Bear trend experiencing a pullback/correction phase

regime_spike_and_channel.description: Trend structure with initial spike followed by orderly channel

regime_broad_channel.description: Wide channel with significant swings between boundaries

location_near_ema20.description: Price within a few ticks of the 20-bar EMA

location_at_measured_move_target.description: Price reaching a measured move projection

location_bottom_of_range.description: Price at lower boundary of trading range

location_top_of_range.description: Price at upper boundary of trading range

pressure_sell_climax.description: Climactic selling with potential exhaustion bottom

pressure_buy_climax.description: Climactic buying with potential exhaustion top

pressure_climactic.description: Extreme price action indicating potential exhaustion

pressure_orderly.description: Controlled price movement without panic or climax

pressure_strong_bear_closes.description: Repeated bars closing near lows indicating selling pressure

pressure_strong_bull_closes.description: Repeated bars closing near highs indicating buying pressure

pressure_failed_follow_through_down.description: Downside follow-through attempt fails, suggesting buying pressure

pressure_failed_follow_through_up.description: Upside follow-through attempt fails, suggesting selling pressure

outcome_bounce_likely.description: Context suggests high probability of bounce/reversal up

outcome_reversal_possible.description: Context suggests potential for trend reversal

outcome_continuation_likely.description: Context suggests trend continuation is probable

outcome_two_sided_likely.description: Context suggests both directions are viable (range behavior)

outcome_trap_risk.description: Context suggests elevated risk of trapping traders

outcome_bull_trap_risk.description: Context suggests risk of trapping longs (failed breakout up)

outcome_bear_trap_risk.description: Context suggests risk of trapping shorts (failed breakout down)

failed_wedge_bottom.description: Wedge bottom pattern that fails to reverse up

failed_wedge_top.description: Wedge top pattern that fails to reverse down

failed_double_bottom.description: Double bottom pattern that fails to reverse up

failed_double_top.description: Double top pattern that fails to reverse down

first_reversal_failed.description: First reversal attempt fails to sustain

body_size_large.description: Large bar body relative to recent bars

body_size_medium.description: Medium bar body relative to recent bars

body_size_small.description: Small bar body relative to recent bars

pattern_role_signal_bar.description: Bar that signals a potential entry

pattern_role_follow_through.description: Bar that confirms or denies a signal

lifecycle_forming.description: Pattern/setup is forming but not yet confirmed (Schema V3)

lifecycle_expired.description: Pattern/setup has expired without resolution (Schema V3)

phase_bucket_early.description: Early phase of trading session (Schema V3)

phase_bucket_mid.description: Mid phase of trading session (Schema V3)

phase_bucket_late.description: Late phase of trading session (Schema V3)

lower_low_double_bottom.description: Double bottom with lower low variant

higher_high_double_top.description: Double top with higher high variant

bull_trend_from_the_open.description: Bull trend starting from market open

bear_trend_from_the_open.description: Bear trend starting from market open

major_bull_surprise.description: Major surprise bar in bull direction

major_bear_surprise.description: Major surprise bar in bear direction

lower_high_major_trend_reversal.description: Major trend reversal at lower high

higher_low_major_trend_reversal.description: Major trend reversal at higher low

lower_low_major_trend_reversal.description: Major trend reversal at lower low

higher_high_major_trend_reversal.description: Major trend reversal at higher high
